description: Review of thin-film encapsulation for OLEDs: barrier classes and their measured WVTRs, the ~1% craze strain of inorganic barrier layers (quoting Jen 2011's 1.19 +/- 0.22% for 20 nm ALD Al2O3), and inorganic/organic dyad stacks that hold 3.1e-5 g/m2/day at 1.09% tensile strain. 61 pages.
attribution: Li, S.; Lan, L.; Li, M.; Gao, Z.; Yan, X.; Fu, D.; Sun, X. Thin-Film Encapsulation for OLEDs and Its Advances: Toward Engineering. Materials 2025, 18, 3175. https://doi.org/10.3390/ma18133175. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

Full text first read this session as PMC JATS XML; the numbers this project quotes (20 nm ALD Al2O3 critical strain 1.19 +/- 0.22%, most metal oxides ~1%, OLED WVTR target 1e-6 g/m2/day, 4x [10 nm Al2O3 + 200 nm p(CHA-co-V3D3)] dyad stack at WVTR 3.1e-5 g/m2/day unchanged at 1.09% tensile strain) were re-verified against this PDF before copying.
